2631: async fn handle_snapshot(cmd: &Value, state: &mut DaemonState) -> Result<Value, String> {
2632:     let mgr = state.browser.as_ref().ok_or("Browser not launched")?;
2633:     let session_id = mgr.active_session_id()?.to_string();
2634: 
2635:     let options = SnapshotOptions {
2636:         selector: cmd
2637:             .get("selector")
2638:             .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
2639:             .map(String::from),
2640:         interactive: cmd
2641:             .get("interactive")
2642:             .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
2643:             .unwrap_or(false),
2644:         compact: cmd
2645:             .get("compact")
2646:             .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
2647:             .unwrap_or(false),
2648:         depth: cmd
2649:             .get("maxDepth")
2650:             .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
2651:             .map(|d| d as usize),
2652:         urls: cmd.get("urls").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
2653:     };
2654: 
2655:     state.ref_map.clear();
2656:     let tree = snapshot::take_snapshot(
2657:         &mgr.client,
2658:         &session_id,
2659:         &options,
2660:         &mut state.ref_map,
2661:         state.active_frame_id.as_deref(),
2662:         &state.iframe_sessions,
2663:     )
2664:     .await?;
2665: 
2666:     let url = mgr.get_url().await.unwrap_or_default();
2667: 
2668:     let refs: serde_json::Map<String, Value> = state
2669:         .ref_map
2670:         .entries_sorted()
2671:         .into_iter()
2672:         .map(|(ref_id, entry)| {
2673:             let mut obj = serde_json::Map::new();
2674:             obj.insert("role".into(), Value::String(entry.role));
2675:             obj.insert("name".into(), Value::String(entry.name));
2676:             (ref_id, Value::Object(obj))
2677:         })
2678:         .collect();
2679: 
2680:     Ok(json!({ "snapshot": tree, "origin": url, "refs": refs }))
2681: }
